title: Dip in gold price puts the sparkle back into festive and wedding buying, jewellers see 10-12% rise in Dhanteras sales
summary: Gold prices have dropped significantly, encouraging consumers to return to jewellery stores for upcoming purchases. The correction in gold prices has led to increased footfalls and advance bookings for weddings. Jewellers expect a rise in sales volume on Dhanteras, which is an auspicious buying day. Consumers are opting for lightweight jewellery and lower-karat gold to manage budget constraints.

score_reasons: +3 Price shock in a commodity this company is exposed to
direction_reasons: gold prices is handled rather than bought or sold; volume matters more than price
TMB.why_it_matters: This reaches the company indirectly via its commodity exposure to gold prices. The parts of the business most likely touched are pricing, input cost, demand. Classified as commodity.
